Thanks again for the time earlier — great to learn about NovaHealth's plan to pilot LLM-powered triage in the patient intake flow. Per our call, summary and immediate asks:  

- What we discussed: 1) 2-week pilot scope (20K monthly tokens), 2) dedicated model variant (gpt-family open model) with prefix caching, 3) metrics: P99 latency target ~350ms, cost target ~$X/token.
- Next steps for procurement: your vendor onboarding team needs Redwood's W-9 and ACH remit details so we can be added to your vendor portal and begin invoicing.
- Timeline we heard: procurement kick-off this week, vendor portal completion target by end of next week.

I can drop the W-9 into your portal once you share the invite link, or I can upload it to whatever vendor system you use (Coupa/Ariba/Workday). If helpful, I can also introduce Marissa (ops) to your procurement contact to answer any tax/finance questions.

Could you confirm: 1) who on your side is owning the vendor invite, and 2) preferred method to send the W-9/ACH?

I'll hold a short technical kickoff calendar invite after vendor setup is done (20–30 min).

Appreciate it — speak soon.

Best,
